minutes.headline: Select Board amended an earth removal permit and deferred a Marshall Park ARPA decision, targeting May 9.
minutes.summary: The board read a press release on the FY23 tax bill mailing dates and abatement deadlines, amended an earth removal permit, accepted emergency plan changes, and made two ratifications and an agricultural commission appointment. The Parks Commission presented a Marshall Park funding plan and a request for ARPA money; the board expressed support but deferred any commitment, targeting May 9. The board also heard capital plan and warrant updates, agreed on a consent calendar, and went into executive session on fire union bargaining.

what_happened.line: The Select Board deferred a Marshall Park funding request that included federal pandemic relief (ARPA) money, targeting May 9 to take it up.
The Parks Commission presented its Marshall Park cost to date, phased construction estimates and funding scenarios; the board voiced support but made no commitment.
The board voted to amend an earth removal permit by removing land sold for a warehouse, leaving the remainder under the permit.
The board accepted the fire chief's changes to the emergency management plan and appointed a member to the agricultural commission.
The board agreed to a consent calendar of town meeting articles with article one removed, then went into executive session on fire union bargaining.

why_it_matters: The Marshall Park project could be paid for with ARPA money, with borrowing, or with grants, and which mix is chosen affects how much debt lands on the tax levy and the town's debt policy limit.
A late invoice for last year's stormwater coalition membership would be paid from free cash, which raises the free cash used in the budget that town meeting will be asked to vote.
watch_next: May 9: the date the board targeted to take up the Marshall Park ARPA funding request.
April 25: the next Select Board meeting; none is scheduled for next week.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on all five non-procedural votes (permit amendment, emergency plan, Agricultural Commission appointment, two ratifications), and the differences in names and figures are mostly caption errors. The thing to know: our minutes list the Marshall Park ARPA target date, the consent calendar, the historical commission vacancy decision and the meeting schedule as decisions, but the official excerpt does not record them in the same way, and the two disagree on who is "Heather" (official lists Sroka absent, Lemieux as town manager) and on the ARPA figures.
